title: Discover the True Identity of the 12 Tribes of Israel | Read Ezekiel 37:16-22
cleanTitle: Discover the True Identity of the 12 Tribes of Israel | Read Ezekiel 37:16-22
segments: I'm Judah, the so-called African-Amean,
the lion of the southern kingdom. We're
waking up now. I'm Benjamin, the
so-called West Indian, the wolf of Zion.
I move fast, talk real. We're waking up
now. I'm Levi, the so-called Haitian.
Priest of the Lord. We taught the law,
now we stand to enforce it. We're waking
up now. I'm Ephraim, the so-called
Puerto Rican. I lead the Northern
Kingdom. We rising and we waking up now.
I'm an so-called Cuban. Strong like the
ox. Firstborn of Joseph, still standing.
We waking up now. I'm Simeon, so-called
Dominican. I don't forget, I don't fold.
We bring the sword of truth. We waking
up now. I'm Zebulon, the so-called
Panameanian in Guatemala. We come from
the coastlines. We built, we bled, but
now we rise. We waking up now. I'm Gad,
the so-called Native American. They
overcame us with war. Now we rise with
truth. We waking up now. I'm Reuben, the
so-called simol. We survived the swamps,
the raids, the lies. But now we stand
up. We waking up now. I'm Asher, the
so-called Colombian to Uruguayan. From
olives to oil, we were blessed to anoint
kings. But now we waking up. I'm
Issakar, the so-called Mexican. We bore
the burden in silence, but now we rise.
We waking up now. I'm Naftali, the
so-called Chilean and Argentinian. Swift
as a deer, but now our steps return
home. We waking up now.
